skill_name: Identify and explain a new trend in digital marketing.
workflow: One of the newest trends in digital marketing is personalization. Instead of creating generic content for a wide audience, companies are now enabling their customers to create personalized content that resonates with them. Companies are collecting customer data, such as purchase and browsing history, to create a more tailored experience for their customers.
